notation: S is ESP at entry; [S] return address, [S+4] one4-byte scalar.
match_path: At shared epilogue ESP=S-12 assuming initial/step callees normally return without net stack change. PopEDI/ESI/EBP ->ESP=S; ret4 pops returnaddress+one4-byte argument ->callerESP=S+8.
fallback_path: 004C7EE3 pushes scalar ->ESP=S-16; directcall004C7DC0 supplies one stack argument plusECXreceiver. No addESP4 follows. Balanced shared epilogue therefore requires the fallback helper to consume/otherwise balance that4-byte argument on normal return. Its actual ret/body is not inspected and not independently proved.
convention_conclusion: ECX receiver + one stack scalar + callee ret4 is thiscall-compatible x8632. Language/type/name and callee stack policies are not proved by this body alone.
